title: Sei Quartetti Concertanti Per Due Violini Alto é Violoncello : Op. 27. 1791 | Monograph DMS 51778
gerard_established_by: SBB title: 'Sei Quartetti Concertanti ... Op. 27'. Publisher's op. 27 is Gerard's Op. 24: RISM 840022728 is 'Minuetto del III Quartetto nelle op. 27' = G192 and 840022729 'Larghetto del IV Quartetto nella Op. 27' = G190, both Op. 24.
rism_related_established_by: This copy is not in RISM -- it was found on a library portal. These are RISM's records for the same print of the same works (GerB 189, 190, 191, 192, 193, 194), matched on the Gérard set. They describe the edition, not this copy.
